title: Klippenstein Crosspost: Terms of Service
author: Ken Klippenstein
content:
Klippenstein Crosspost is a private tool that Ken Klippenstein uses to publish
his own videos to his own social media accounts. It is not offered to the
public, and no one else may use it.

The operator is responsible for everything posted with it and for following
each platform's rules, including the [YouTube Terms of
Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms) and [TikTok's Terms of
Service](https://www.tiktok.com/legal/terms-of-service).

The tool is provided as is, without warranties. Questions:
[kenneth.klippenstein@gmail.com](mailto:kenneth.klippenstein@gmail.com).
